# DOC_PROTOCOL (fixture) -- budgets for the Provenance Map cloud gate

## 2. The doc set: owner, budget, over-budget action

| doc | owns | budget |
|---|---|---|
| START_HERE.md | routing | 6 KB |
| CURRENT_STATE.md | reality NOW: tests table, gotchas | 1 KB |
| MODULE_ROADMAP.md | build order + per-unit status | 20 KB |
| DECISION_LOG.md | append-only rationale | no cap (indexed; tool-pull only) |
| DECISION_LOG_INDEX.md | one routing row per decision | 20 KB |
| FANOUT_ORCHESTRATOR_HANDOFF.md | the one live handoff | 24 KB |
| research/&lt;date&gt;-*.md | dated research digests | 10 KB each |

Budgets = actual size at adoption. Over-budget action: the session that busts it slims it.
